serverInfo.name: Astraeusio Space Weather
serverInfo.description: Real-time space weather data and ML-powered geomagnetic storm forecasting over MCP. Tools cover the Kp index, solar wind, a 3-hour Kp forecast, detected anomalies, near-Earth object close approaches, ISS position, and service health.

tools.name: get_current_kp
tools.description: Get the current Kp index and recent readings from NOAA (no auth required).

tools.name: get_solar_wind
tools.description: Get the latest solar wind speed and density from NOAA DSCOVR (no auth required).

tools.name: get_kp_forecast
tools.description: Get the ML 3-hour Kp forecast with the model spread across 50 inference passes (no auth required).

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Get service health status for all data sources (no auth required).

tools.name: get_anomalies
tools.description: Get detected space weather anomalies: storms, flares, solar wind spikes, asteroid close approaches. Requires Bearer token.

tools.name: get_neo
tools.description: Get NASA near-Earth object close approaches for the next 7 days with hazard flags. Requires Bearer token.

tools.name: get_iss_position
tools.description: Get current ISS position, altitude, and velocity. Requires Bearer token.
